name: ridequest-system-design-game
description: RideQuest - Become the Architect: An interactive educational system design game for first-year computer science students

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const files = ['icons.js', 'sound.js', 'levels-data.js', 'diorama-engine.js', 'simulation.js', 'boss-canvas.js', 'game.js']; const out = files.map(f => fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')).join('\n\n'); fs.writeFileSync('bundle.js', out); console.log('Bundle built successfully');"

author: Google DeepMind Antigravity Team
